name: Nextiva
description_en:
Nextiva is a product in the Call center category. Its directory profile covers Outbound Call Center, Inbound Call Center, Concurrency Support, Live Chat, Queue Management (Calls), IVR Support, Auto Call Recording, Call Monitoring.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS) Desktop App (Windows, Mac). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $18.95. Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: exchange messages with visitors or customers in real time. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
